page.heading: Skills

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill, import one from a file, or fetch one from a URL.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

page.subtitle: Reusable prompt blocks agents pull into a review. Toggle a skill off to exclude it everywhere.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: Phrase as a directive — this is how agents see the skill.

stats.loadError: Could not load stats for this skill.
stats.noAgents: No agents use this skill yet. Link it from an agent’s Skills tab.
stats.noFindings: No findings yet — numbers appear after a review run that used this skill.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version; restoring an old one adds a new version with its body. Newest first.
versions.loadError: Could not load versions for this skill.

diff.unchanged: {count, plural, one {# unchanged line} other {# unchanged lines}}
diff.tooLarge: This change is too large to diff — switch to Rendered to read the body.
diff.sameAsCurrent: v{version} is identical to the current version (v{current}).

restore.title: Restore v{version}?
restore.message: This creates v{next} with v{version}’s body. The current body is kept in history.

injection.badgeTitle: Prompt injection patterns were found. This skill is automatically blocked.
injection.toggleBlocked: Blocked — injection detected. This skill cannot be enabled.
injection.stillBlocked: Saved, but the body still contains prompt injection patterns — the skill stays blocked.

banner.title: INJECTION DETECTED — DO NOT ENABLE
banner.body: This skill contains prompt injection patterns. It has been automatically blocked.

matches.title: Why it was flagged
matches.hint: Edit the body to remove these patterns; a clean body lifts the block (the skill is not enabled automatically).

delete.title: Delete "{name}"?
delete.message: "{name}" will be unlinked from {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}. This can’t be undone.
delete.messageUnused: "{name}" is not linked to any agent. This can’t be undone.
delete.messageGeneric: "{name}" will be unlinked from every agent. This can’t be undone.
